risks.title: Dependence on Government Contracts
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on contracts with the U.S. federal government (56.5% of revenue), which could pose a risk if these contracts are terminated or not renewed. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit and Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has bank debt related to customer payment delays and high borrowing costs, although overall leverage is relatively low. A 100 bp increase in SOFR would result in $7.0 M of additional annual interest expense. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive government services market, which could be a risk if competitors offer similar services at lower prices. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Government Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict government regulations and changes in public policy, including the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) of 2025 which could affect state programs. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impact of Post-Medicaid Redetermination Normalization
risks.score_rationale: The U.S. Services segment experienced a 7.7% revenue decline following the conclusion of Medicaid redetermination activities that had temporarily increased volumes. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and International Business Divestitures Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally and divested its Australian and Korean operations in Q1 2025, resulting in a loss and an increase in the effective tax rate to 28.3%. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology and Obsolescence Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company uses technology to deliver services to governments, which could be a risk if these technologies are not up to date or if the company is unable to modernize them. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company MMS has no significant mentions related to artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts. Its business appears to focus on government services and traditional technology solutions.
